messages.author: 0ca993d2597fc65c
messages.subject: compile inla
parts:
How do we compile and install INLA from source and point it to a custom library PATH? The pre-compiled version is looking at default library PATHs which are outdated for us. We're running CentOS 6. The source code we're looking at is from:  
https://bitbucket.org/hrue/r-inla 

thanks

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] compile inla
parts:
Hi

download

www.r-inla-download.org/hrue/hfiles/build64.tgz


unpack it, and you should be able to do

make update

which will download new updates and recompile. or you can set the
INLA_TAG variable to compile a spesific version (see the makefile)


you can also do

make taucs

to recompile the TAUCS library, and similar with other libraries. see
the makefile

this tgz file is currently in use for Ubuntu16.04

let me know if you run into problems.

H
